column1: # Russian plurals: one / few / many / other — four forms where every other locale
# here needs one or two. CLDR categories for ru:
#   one   1, 21, 31…   (n%10==1 and n%100!=11)      узел    ошибка   макрос
#   few   2-4, 22-24…  (n%10 in 2..4, n%100 not 12..14)  узла  ошибки  макроса
#   many  0, 5-20, 25… (everything else, integers)  узлов   ошибок   макросов
#   other fractions ("1,5 узла") — takes the genitive singular, same as few.
